grammar.composition_primitive: Cool mint geometric hero with centered product statement; a horizontal row of distinct numeric offer cards follows; a bordered notice panel separates terms from further navigation.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: Centered short proposition; large numeric rates inside bounded cards; terms and dates smaller but still adjacent to the offer.
grammar.typography_observation: Centered short proposition; large numeric rates inside bounded cards; terms and dates smaller but still adjacent to the offer.
grammar.media_observation: No dominant lifestyle photograph in the observed crop; graphic color fields and compact product marks carry the entry.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Headline, number cards, bordered notice, then service routes; clear transition from offer to qualification information.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Offer cards stack or become a narrow sequential row; headline wraps; notice remains visible before secondary routes.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: headline, numeric values, qualifying copy, disclosure and links. CSS: grid cards and visible boundary; no values as raster images.
misuse_constraints: Every rate, period and condition requires claim-unit source verification and expiry review.
Never separate terms from the offer by a large scroll distance.
Do not imply product suitability or returns from the visual arrangement.
